cases.setup: Pinned public Python AST linter checkout with incomplete tuple coverage and accessible public tests.
checks: Produces a review record with current semantic owner bindings and hashed code anchors.
Records supported AST shapes and actual diagnostic output for empty, nested constant, variable-containing, singleton, and scalar examples.
Marks missing observations UNKNOWN rather than successful.

cases.setup: Inspection confirms compatible policy, the classification gap, supported AST variants, and all required owner bindings.
checks: The diff uses recursive all-elements tuple classification and includes the empty tuple.
Singleton exclusion is explicit; tuples are not exempt merely because their elements are singletons.
The comparison rule checks either operand for both identity operators and advances through chained pairs.
Diagnostic text and public assertions reflect the expanded coverage.
The modifying Action retains explicit validation and invalidates stale pre-edit diagnostic observations.

cases.setup: Repaired public checkout with located regression owner and current public Oracle commands bound.
checks: Executes the bound public commands and records exit status and relevant diagnostic output.
Observes identity-literal diagnostics for empty and nested all-constant tuples.
Observes no identity-literal diagnostic for variable-containing tuples or singleton-only identity operands.
Checks scalar diagnostics, operand symmetry, is not, chained pairs, and normal child traversal.
Records failures and untested runtime branches explicitly.
Does not infer whole-project or cross-project success from changed-test-only results.
